column2: Fastest: Ancient spellbook > Annakarl Teleport (Demonic Ruins), then run north-west to the middle of the deep-Wilderness scan area. Alternatively: Ctrl+T > Slayer > Level 99+ > Abyssal Beasts, step into the obelisk just north of the landing > 5. More > 2. Level 50, run west to the middle of the scan area. Third option: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Agility > 52 - Wilderness Course, run east to the middle of the scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Fairy ring DLQ (north Kharidian Desert) (portable fairy ring required to be the fastest), then run north to the middle of the scan area. Alternatively: Ctrl+T > Locations > Dominion Tower, run south-east to the middle of the scan area, staying east of the River Elid. Third option: Traveller's necklace > Desert Eagle's Eyrie, run south to the middle of the scan area. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Tirannwn lodestone, then run north-west to the forest west of Lletya. Alternatively: Amulet of farming > Tree Patches > 0. Next page > 2. Lletya Fruit Tree Patch, run west to the forest west of Lletya. Third option: Fairy ring DLR (Poison Waste, Isafdar), run north to the middle of the scan area. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Modern spellbook > Varrock Teleport, then run south to the middle of the scan area. Alternatively: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Farming > Varrock Tree, run south to the middle of the scan area. Third option: Varrock lodestone, run north to the middle of the scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Dave's spellbook > Ardougne (West Ardougne), then run north-east to the wall between West and East Ardougne, the middle of the scan area. Alternatively: Ardougne lodestone, run west to the middle of the scan area. Third option: Fairy ring BIS (Ardougne Zoo), run north-west to the middle of the scan area. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Thieving > Dwarf Traders, then run east to the middle of the city scan area. Alternatively: Hazelmere's signet ring > Keldagrim, run east to the middle of the city scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Menaphos lodestone, then run north-west to the middle of the city scan area. Alternatively: Amulet of farming > Bushes and Cacti Patches > 7. Menaphos Cactus Patch, run south-west to the middle of the city scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Hunter > Falconry, then run south-west to the middle of the hunter area. Alternatively: Fairy ring AKQ (Piscatoris Hunter area), run south-east to the middle of the hunter area. Third option: Eagles' Peak lodestone, run north to the hunter area. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Slayer > Brimhaven Dungeon, then run south-west to the middle of the scan area (check the floor the clue shows). Alternatively: Karamja lodestone, run west to the Brimhaven Dungeon entrance, pay Saniboch and enter, then head to the middle of the scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Taverley lodestone, then run south to the dungeon ladder near the wheat field, climb down and head into the dungeon. Alternatively: 120 Dungeoneering cape > 9. Taverley hellhound dungeon, run south-east to the middle of the scan area. Final step: Start scanning.
Not available on Kavros.

Fastest: Fairy ring ALQ (Haunted Woods) (portable fairy ring required to be the fastest), then run south-west to the middle of the woods scan area. Alternatively: Amulet of farming > Herb Patches > 3. Haunted Woods Herb Patch, run south-west to the middle of the scan area. Third option: Canifis lodestone, run south-east to the Haunted Woods. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Fairy ring CKR (south of Tai Bwo Wannai) (portable fairy ring required to be the fastest), then run south-east to the Kharazi Jungle along the south coast. Alternatively: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Woodcutting > Overgrown Idol (Karamja), run south-west to the Kharazi Jungle. Third option: 120 Slayer cape > 6. Duradel, run south to the Kharazi Jungle. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ctrl+T > Locations > Zanaris, then run north to the middle of Zanaris. Alternatively: Dave's spellbook > Lumbridge (swamp platform), run south-west to the shed in Lumbridge Swamp, enter it wielding a dramen or lunar staff, then head into Zanaris. Third option: 120 Slayer cape > 4. Chaeldar, run west to the middle of Zanaris. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Dave's spellbook > Lumbridge (swamp platform), then run south-west to the swamp cave entrance, climb down with a light source and head into the caves. Alternatively: Lumbridge lodestone, run south-west to the swamp cave entrance, climb down with a light source. Third option: Ctrl+T > Locations > Lumbridge Church, run south-west to the swamp cave entrance, climb down with a light source. Final step: Start scanning.
Fastest: Ctrl+T > Monsters > Yaks (lands at the yak pen on Neitiznot). Final step: Start scanning; Jatizso is across the rope bridge to the east.

Fastest: Dave's spellbook > Falador (south gate), then run north to the middle of the city scan area. Alternatively: Skills necklace > Mining Guild, run north-west to the middle of the city scan area. Third option: Ring of respawn > Falador Castle, run east to the middle of the city scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Lumbridge lodestone, then run west to Lumbridge Castle, go down to the cellar, through the hole into the caves and the Dorgeshuun mines, and on to Dorgesh-Kaan (needs Death to the Dorgeshuun, as in RS3). Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Slayer > Fremennik Dungeon, then run west to the middle of the dungeon scan area. Alternatively: Fairy ring AJR (Fremennik Slayer Cave), run east to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon entrance, enter and head into the chambers. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ancient spellbook > Carrallangar Teleport (Graveyard of Shadows), then run north-west to the Wilderness Crater. Alternatively: Wilderness Crater lodestone, run north to the crater. Third option: Games necklace > Corporeal Beast, exit the cave, then run north-west to the crater. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Prifddinas lodestone, then run east to the middle of the scan area (upper level, around the central platform). Alternatively: 120 Slayer cape > 8. Morvran, run north-east to the middle of the scan area. Final step: Start scanning.

Fastest: Ctrl+T > Locations > Nardah, then run west out of Nardah to the Heart of Gielinor entrance, go down into the Heart and start on the entrance platform. Alternatively: Fairy ring DLQ (north Kharidian Desert), run south-west to the Heart of Gielinor entrance west of Nardah, go down into the Heart and start on the entrance platform. Portable fairy ring can be made in ;;ig. An unlimited version can be bought for 5 Kavros dollars. Final step: Start scanning.
